entries.title: Psalms 95:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: God's - Above all that are called God's angels, earthly potentates, and especially the false gods of the Heathen.

entries.title: Psalms 95:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Hand - Under his government. Strength - The strongest or highest mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 95:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Pasture - Whom he feeds and keeps in his own pasture, or in the land which he hath appropriated to himself. The sheep - Which are under his special care. Today - Forthwith or presently.

entries.title: Psalms 95:8
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Harden not - By obstinate unbelief. Provocation - In that bold and wicked contest with God in the wilderness. Temptation - In the day in which you tempted me.

entries.title: Psalms 95:9
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Works - Both of mercy, and of justice.

entries.title: Psalms 95:10
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Do err - Their hearts are insincere and bent to backsliding. Not known - After all my teaching and discoveries of myself to them; they did not know, nor consider, those great things which I had wrought for them.

entries.title: Psalms 95:11
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: My rest - Into the promised land, which is called the rest, Deut 12:9 .
